what: Live gate: every model must have an entry in lib/caps.mjs with cap_enforced true, dated provider sources, and the plan must record the same reasoning controls (Sonnet effort medium; GPT reasoning_effort medium; DeepSeek thinking disabled; Gemini thinking_level low).
